getSettingValue.detail: no Electron.* platform settings in this port
getSettingValue.why: autoLaunch, minimizeToTray, alwaysShowMenuBar, hardware acceleration, content protection and warnBeforeExit are the browser's decisions, not the app's. initialise() reports all six as unsupported, so PlatformSettingsHandler.setup() (apps/web/src/settings/handlers/PlatformSettingsHandler.ts) never calls this.

setSettingValue.detail: no Electron.* platform settings in this port
setSettingValue.why: the write half of the same six settings. canSetValue is false for all of them, so this is never reached either -- refused rather than silently accepting a value nothing reads.
